articles.title: Markets live: ASX to rise ahead of inflation figures, despite Wall Street's tech sell-off
articles.titleEn: Markets live: ASX to rise ahead of inflation figures, despite Wall Street's tech sell-off
articles.summary: The Australian share market is expected to rise despite a major sell-off across US tech, AI and semiconductor stocks, which resulted in steep losses on Wall Street. The ABS will release its May inflation data, which will be impacted by sharp falls in petrol and diesel prices. Follow live.
